services.name: Sound Bath & Clay Play with Claydd
services.desc: Join us for a day of healing through sound and clay. We’ll begin with a guided meditation and sound bath led by a CLAYDD healer, creating space to slow down, reconnect with ourselves and the land. After grounding through these practices, we’ll transition into a hands-on clay experience where participants are invited

blurb: Craft Contemporary is featured in the March issue of Architectural Digest! This special issue is a love letter to Los Angeles, its design history, contemporary creativity, and resilience in the wake of last year's devastating fires. We are grateful to be included among the cultural institutions shaping the city and supporting its renewal.
